scoring_justification: Formation energies are compared to paper-reported values (2.21 eV, 0.72 eV) with tolerance 0.3 eV; band gaps are checked by threshold conditions, consistent with the paper's conclusion on band inversion reversal. No external labels or holdouts are required.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference formation energies and band gap thresholds for scoring
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper main text (vacancy formation energy 2.21 eV, adatom 0.72 eV; band gap thresholds from expected Dirac crossing behaviour)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from published paper values; thresholds based on physical expectation of gap opening for vacancy and near-zero gap for pristine/adatom
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are direct from the paper; thresholds are the standard qualitative prediction from the paper's conclusion (gap opening indicates band inversion reversal).

outputs.description: Defect formation energies (in eV) for a Te vacancy and a Te adatom in monolayer WTe2 under Te-rich conditions, derived from DFT total energies.
Band gaps (in eV) along Γ‑X for pristine, Te‑vacancy, and Te‑adatom supercells. The verifier will evaluate these against reference thresholds to assess the paper's topological claims.

output_contract.notes: Formation energies compared to paper values with tolerance 0.3 eV. Band gaps audited by threshold; the exact thresholds are not disclosed to the agent.
